title: Pre-Analysis (Closed) — Generator Control Unit Thermal Protection, First Issue
abstract: Closed pre-analysis re-opened in 2024 to support the spares release of the first issue protection standard, confirming that the configuration load could be supplied to operators independently of the bonding strap kit.

sections.objective: Establish, for the spares release, whether the first issue configuration load could be supplied on its own to operators who had already fitted the bonding strap, and what documentation would have to move with it.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed. The retrofit bulletin was written as a single accomplishment covering both the load and the strap, so supplying the load alone left no instruction for the operator to follow and no record entry to make; that was the item that decided the outcome. The functional test task was already written per configuration standard and needed no change, which removed the largest suspected obstacle. The second issue was in design at the time and would supersede the whole protection block within two years, so any separate spares provision would have a short life. The work was handed to customer services as a documentation question rather than an engineering one.
sections.next_steps: Handed to customer services to answer through a bulletin revision rather than through a spares release. No engineering action was raised and the work order was closed.

similarity_seeds: supplying a software load without the hardware it was released with

tasks.title: Check the bulletin accomplishment against a load-only supply
Confirm the functional test covers both configuration standards

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin covers the load and the bonding strap as one accomplishment. A load supplied on its own would leave the operator without an instruction to follow or a record entry to make.
expected_findings.resolution: Revise the bulletin to allow a load-only accomplishment for aircraft that already carry the strap.

expected_findings.rationale: The functional test was already written per configuration standard and reported the standard fitted, so a load-only supply needed no change to it.
expected_findings.resolution: No action. Recorded so that the next reviewer does not repeat the check.

expected_findings.rationale: The second issue was already in design and would replace the whole protection block within two years, so any separate spares arrangement for the first issue load would have had a short life.
expected_findings.resolution: Note the supersession date in the spares plan and do not create a separate part number.

type_data.conclusion: Closed. The question was a documentation one and was handed to customer services; no engineering change was raised.
